1 · Intro

When to use it.

Use Change Assignment to update something on an employee's current assignment. Start from Employment Info so you can see the record before you change it.

For a single change (location, manager, working hours, direct reports) there's a direct action. Use Change Assignment for broader changes.

Use this whenAn employee's assignment needs an update, such as location, hours, business title, or person type.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle HCM. Check off each step as you go.

Watch-outs

  • Don't change an employee's position here. Moving someone to another position in your business unit is a transfer, so it's tracked and reported.
  • After a position reclassification, person type, location, working hours, and hourly salary don't flow from the position. Update them here.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

  • Oracle: Redwood employment pages incl. Change Assignment and Change Working Hours (26C) (opens in a new tab)

3 · Knowledge check

Check your understanding.

Three questions. You get feedback on each answer. All three right completes the course.

Q1Where do you start an assignment change?

Q2An employee moves to a different position in your business unit. Which action?

Q3A reclassification was approved on the position. What do you still update on the assignment?

4 · Job aid

Keep it handy.

HCM Academy job aid · Assignment Changes

Change Assignment

Use when: An employee's assignment needs an update, such as location, hours, business title, or person type. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Open the employee's Employment Info.
  2. Pick the action.
  3. Select any extra sections you'll update.
  4. Enter the effective date.
  5. Action: Assignment change. Pick the reason.
  6. Update the fields.
  7. Review salary if you selected it, then Submit.

Watch-outs

  • Don't change an employee's position here. Moving someone to another position in your business unit is a transfer, so it's tracked and reported.
  • After a position reclassification, person type, location, working hours, and hourly salary don't flow from the position. Update them here.
